name: Validation and Leakage
description: Measure a model honestly when data arrives in time order and leaks are everywhere.

lessonNames.l5-shuffling-lies: Why shuffling a time series lies

lessonObjectives.l1-holding-back: Evaluate a model on data it was not fitted on.
lessonObjectives.l2-rotating-folds: Run $k$-fold cross-validation and read its spread.
lessonObjectives.l3-tuning: Tune a model by cross-validation without touching the test set.
lessonObjectives.l4-nested: Use nested cross-validation for an honest estimate after tuning.
lessonObjectives.l5-shuffling-lies: See how random folds let a model peek at the future.
lessonObjectives.l6-walking-forward: Validate with expanding and rolling windows.
lessonObjectives.l7-purging: Purge training labels that overlap the test period and add an embargo.
lessonObjectives.l8-regime-shift: Spot a regime change in fold-by-fold results.
lessonObjectives.l9-knows-the-answer: Find a feature that leaks the target.
lessonObjectives.l10-scaling-with-future: Fit preprocessing inside each fold with a pipeline.
lessonObjectives.l11-dead-companies: Spot survivorship bias in a dataset of shares.
lessonObjectives.l12-too-many-models: Estimate how much choosing the best of many models inflates its score.
